rules.label: Pages and people you don't follow

verified: 2026-10-01: in-feed Stories (live report H), live DOM, logged-in home feed, English UI, 40 scrolls: a feed unit ([aria-posinset], role=article) holding a div[role=region] (localised aria-label, "stories in feed") with all of its 10-11 a[href*="/stories/"] cards inside it, and a "Stories" heading outside the region. 19 ordinary posts in the same run carried one /stories/ link (the author avatar, aria-label "<name>, view story") and no role=region at all, so the stories rule matches a story link inside a region, not a story link alone. ARIA roles are not localised. 2026-09-25: Stories bar at the top of the home feed is div[role="region"] with a localised aria-label ("Stories" in English), about 192px tall, inside [role="main"] but not inside [role="feed"], containing a[href*="/stories/create"]. 2026-09-24 (later): Daniel confirmed it works on his logged-in feed, feed included. Earlier that day, live DOM, logged-in home feed, English UI, 51 posts scrolled. Right rail: the 'Sponsored' section is an h3 plus ad cards, each an a[aria-label=Advertiser] linking out through l.facebook.com; the smallest div holding both is the module. Feed: a 'Suggested for you' groups carousel carries that exact aria-label. No sponsored feed post appeared in 51 posts, so the feed ad markers (attributionsrc privacy_sandbox, /ads/about, aria-labelledby resolving to 'Sponsored') are still from known markup, not seen live. Timestamps' aria-labelledby resolve to e.g. '6 hours ago'. Dutch UI strings unchecked. Suggested (live 2026-09-24, English UI): a post from a group you are not in has a role=button reading exactly 'Join' inside the profile_name header; a page you do not follow, 'Follow' in the same place. The 'Reels' module is a feed unit headed by an h3 reading 'Reels'. 'Your group suggestions' is a feed unit whose cards carry aria-label 'Join group'. Dutch, German and French strings are baseline guesses, UNVERIFIED live. 2026-09-28: suggested applies on the home feed (/ and /home.php) and the groups feed (/groups/feed/) only (suggestedPaths). The unit selector also matches page, profile and single-group timelines, where a Follow or Join button only means the user doesn't follow a page they opened on purpose. Sponsored detection still runs everywhere. Paths UNVERIFIED live.
